evidence: Clean Chrome session at 1440x1100 completed all five outfit-tab task IDs through actual DOM clicks against the four-screen main prototype.
Category switch changed both active chip and reason-led feed content.
Detail view exposed suitability, outfit formula, and avoidance guidance.
Lower-cost alternative sheet exposed product information and price.
AI try-on entry state opened with an explicit no-backend prototype limitation.
Final browser report recorded zero page errors and zero console errors.
Three rendered visual-direction screenshots and entry/detail/product/AI screenshots provide selection and flow evidence.
All four HTML artifacts embed frozen PNG assets as base64; the device implementation only partially ports the ios_frame.jsx structure and is not a complete real use of the source component.
deviations: The implementation did not fully and directly use vendor/huashu-design/assets/ios_frame.jsx; it partially transplanted the structure and styles into a custom DOM helper.
The three visual directions are not sufficiently structurally independent: they retain substantial shared runtime, content, and phone-flow structure despite surface and feed-layout differences.
Six category labels are visible, but only 通勤、出游、小个子 have distinct frozen-image/card data; 日常、梨形、黄黑皮 fall back to the same default card rather than representing six real category datasets.
Browser QA exercises only the first phone and the 出游 path. It does not verify like/dislike, all four independent phones, all six categories, return navigation, or both AI actions.
Visible S–XL sizing and some suitability/guidance claims are not grounded by the frozen source and are not consistently labeled Mock; only the invented ¥189 price is explicitly labeled Mock.
Subagents were unavailable, so the three directions were produced serially in one context rather than independently in parallel.
Brand verification and new asset acquisition were not performed because the experiment was constrained to frozen local input; only provided local screenshots were used.
